scheme_name: NELP/OALP – Hydrocarbon Exploration for Private Players
overview: The Directorate General of Employment (DGE) under the Ministry of Labour and Employment implements various employment generation schemes and programmes of the Government of India, including the Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY), National Career Service (NCS), and others, aimed at enhancing employability, creating employment opportunities, and supporting vulnerable sections of society through vocational training, job fairs, and direct benefit transfers.
objectives: Incentivize employers for creation of new employment and restoration of loss of employment during the Covid-19 pandemic
Enhance employability of educated SC/ST job seekers through coaching, training, and counselling
Enhance employability of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) through vocational training and vocational rehabilitation
Provide career-related services including jobs from private and government sectors, information on job fairs, job search & matching, career counselling, vocational guidance, and skill development
Provide for free Public Employment Service (PES) under a national authority and lay down standard policies and procedures in consultation with States/UTs
Enhance the employability of educated SC/ST job-seekers registered with Employment Exchanges and NCS Portal through Coaching/Training/Counselling
Enhance the employability of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) through vocational course
Provide for free Public Employment Service (PES) under a national authority and to lay down standard policies and procedures in consultation with the States/UTs for its smooth functioning
eligibility: Establishments already registered before the commencement of ABRY shall have to employ, over and above the reference base, minimum two new employees (if the reference base of employee is less than or equal to 50) and minimum five new employees (if the reference base of employees is more than 50). Such already registered establishments must continue to employ minimum number of additional new employees as specified with respect to the reference base of employees for availing assistance under the Scheme for any wage month. In addition to maintaining the minimum number of additional new employees, the already registered establishments must continue to retain the number of employees taken as reference base of employees for availing assistance under the Scheme for any wage month. For new establishment getting registered with EPFO between 01.10.2020 to 31.03.2022, the reference base of employees shall be treated as zero. If any such establishment registers voluntarily with less than 20 employees and continues to maintain less than 20 employees during the validity period of the Scheme, such establishment will not be allowed to exit from statutory Schemes under EPF & MP Act, 1952 and beneficiaries who received benefit shall not be allowed to make final withdrawals until expiry of a period of two years after validity period of the Scheme. Establishments working as contractors engaged in providing manpower to one or more principal employers shall not claim benefit of employers’ share under the Scheme if the same is claimed or received from the principal employer. Any such amount of employer’s share claimed under the Scheme shall be liable to be refunded to the Central Government. If any establishment being a single legal entity is making compliance under various code numbers obtained from EPFO, then for the purpose of counting the number of 50/1000 employees, wherever applicable for eligibility criteria under the Scheme, all employees in the establishment as a whole shall be included. New employee has to be registered for the Scheme during the period from 01.10.2020 to 31.03.2022 by employer of eligible establishment. The new employee should have Aadhaar seeded Universal Account Number. The benefit under the Scheme shall be paid for the wage months in which he continues to be in employment in any eligible establishment subject to a period of maximum 24 months from date of registration as new employee. Any eligible new employee under the Scheme shall become ineligible if his/her monthly wage exceeds 14999/- at any point of time during the Scheme period. It is clarified that if any new employee is already a registered beneficiary and his/her employer is eligible to or is availing benefits of payment of employer’s share by Central Government under PMRPY/PMPRPY 2016, no such benefit in respect of such new employee shall be available under the Scheme.
benefits: The Central Government will provide subsidy for twenty-four wage months in respect of eligible new employees at the following scale: For Establishments employing up to and including One Thousand (1000 employees (contributing EPF members with UAN) in wage month September, 2020, the employer’s and employee’s share of contribution as per statutory rate applicable to establishment subject to maximum of 24% of wages. These establishments will however continue to get subsidy of employer’s share even if the number of contributing EPF members with UAN exceeds 1000 during the scheme period. For Establishments employing more than One Thousand (1000) employees (contributing EPF members with UAN) in wage month September, 2020, employees’ share of contribution as per statutory rate applicable to establishment subject to maximum of 12% of wages. The Central Government benefit due under the Scheme in respect of new eligible employees will be credited upfront in the Aadhaar seeded UAN of new employees by the EPFO from funds allocated by the Central Government. The eligible candidates are paid a monthly stipend @ Rs. 1,000/- per month per candidate paid subject to condition of 80% or more attendance in a particular month, which is paid directly into the bank account of the beneficiary online through PFMS Portal. Under second Scheme, presently 24 NCSC for DA Centers are working across the country. Out of which 21 centers are implementing DBT Scheme to enhance the employability of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). The eligible candidates are paid a monthly stipend @ Rs.2,500/- per month per candidate subject to condition of 80% or more attendance in a particular month, which is paid directly into the bank account of the beneficiary online through PFMS Portal.

application_process: 1. The employer in relation to any eligible establishment shall first register the establishment under the Scheme disclosing the reference base of employees through a link in the Employer’s login on EPFO Unified Portal. 2. Before registration of the establishment under the Scheme, the employer shall ensure that updated ownership return is already filed with EPFO. 3. Before taking any employee in employment, the employer shall ensure to obtain a declaration as to previous membership of Employees Provident Fund Scheme, 1952 and Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995, EPF member a/c number/UAN in respect of such previous membership as required under Para 34 of the EPF Scheme, 1952 and Para 24 of the EPS, 1995 and retain such declaration. 4. The employer of eligible establishment shall register new employees under the Scheme during the period from 01.10.2020 to 31.03.2022. 5. The employer in relation to any eligible establishment shall file one Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) in respect of all employees for each wage month with respect to new employees in a way that leads to increase in benefits. 6. Any revision/correction/modification in such ECR shall not be allowed for claiming any enhanced benefits at any future date. 7. The ECR for any wage month for claiming the benefits under the Scheme has to be filed by eligible establishment not later than 60 days of the close of that wage month. 8. In case such ECR for any wage month is filed beyond the due date specified in Para 38 of the EPF Scheme, 1952 but within 60 days of close of the wage month, the liability of interest due u/s 7Q of the EPF& MP Act, 1952 on such belated remittances shall be borne by the employer. 9. Since the Central Government is paying the employee’s share of EPF contributions for new employees eligible under the Scheme, the employer shall not make any deduction towards employee’s share of EPF contribution from the monthly wages of any new employee and disburse the wages without such deduction to the new employee concerned and file declaration in regard to above with the ECR. 10. Any violation of this condition will be treated as breach of trust and render the employer liable for appropriate legal action as per law apart from recovery of such amount. 11. Once ECR is uploaded by an employer eligible for benefits, then the challan will separately show the amount of employees’ and employers’ contribution in respect of new employees due from Central Government under the Scheme and the amount payable by the employer. 12. The employer has to remit the payment due from him as reflected in Challan as noted above and complete the process of ECR filing. 13. The Central Government benefit due under the Scheme in respect of new eligible employees will be credited upfront in the Aadhaar seeded UAN of new employees by the EPFO from funds allocated by the Central Government. 14. Wherever employer has filed ECR for wage month of October and November 2020 prior to deployment of facility for registration under the Scheme, benefits due under the Scheme which is already remitted through ECR be reimbursed to employer for employers’ share by way of future adjustments against employer’s share of contribution. 15. The employee’s share of benefit of the respective new eligible employee will also be adjusted in their UANs. 16. Employers and Establishments shall be responsible for the correctness of all particulars submitted for claiming any benefit under the Scheme. 17. Any amount claimed through incorrect or false declaration shall be recoverable besides other action under appropriate provisions of law for making such false declaration. 18. Along with ECR to claim subsidy for any wage month, the employer shall be required to electronically upload a certificate / declaration in format appended below: CERTIFICATE/ DECLARATION OF EMPLOYER That I have read the Scheme Guidelines and declare that my establishment satisfies all the eligibility conditions for receiving benefit from the Central Government for creating new employment . I certify that no deductions towards either employees’ EPF contributions or employers’ EPF/EPS contributions have been made from wages of eligible new employees. That I have neither suppressed any material information nor omitted any particulars and submitted correct information in ECR filed with this declaration to avail the subsidy of employer’s and or employees’ share of contributions in respect of new eligible employees from the Central Government. I undertake that the subsidy received from Central Government under the Scheme shall not booked as expenditure incurred by the establishment or employer for claiming or receiving any benefit / exemption / rebate/ concessions under any law. I understand that the employer is liable to refund the benefit amount and is also liable for any penal action for submitting any incorrect or false information/declaration to avail the Central Government assistance.
required_documents: Updated ownership return filed with EPFO
Declaration as to previous membership of Employees Provident Fund Scheme, 1952 and Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995, EPF member a/c number/UAN
Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) in respect of all employees for each wage month
Additional certificate / declaration by employer if establishment is a contractor providing manpower
deadlines: The Scheme stands commenced from 1st October 2020 and shall remain open for registration of eligible employers and new employees up to 30th June, 2021. The Central Government on 30.06.2021 approved for extension of last date of registration for eligible employers and new employees under the scheme from 30.06.2021 to 31.03.2022. The benefit shall be available for a period of twenty-four months from date of registration of new employee, not later than 31/03/2024 in any case.
